newsitem.title: USA: MobileMedia misses bond interest payments.
newsitem.headline: MobileMedia misses bond interest payments.

text.p: MobileMedia Corp said it did not make Friday's scheduled interest payments on its publicly traded bonds, and that it was continuing to review the situation in light of its cash requirements.
The company, which recently acquired MobileComm, also said it saw integration costs hurting results through the second quarter of 1997.

"Costs from the MobileComm integration continue to impact our results and we expect to carry some additional costs through the integration, which we anticipate will be completed in the second quarter of 1997," said Michael Lorelli, president and chief executive officer.

The paging and personnel communications services provider acquired MobileComm, the paging business of BellSouth Corp on January 4, 1996. On August 31, 1995, it bought the paging business of Dial Page.

In the third quarter 1996, MobileMedia reported a loss of $1.56 per share compared to a proforma consolidated loss of $1.12 per share in the same quarter last year. 1995 results were restated on a proforma basis as if the MobileComm and DialPage acquisitions ahd take effect January 1, 1995.

However, the company said it had identified issues which affected the integration, like continued duplication of costs, and it was implementing an aggressive plan to address them. "We are optimistic that this plan will enable us to leverage our networks, national coverage, and strong market position," Lorelli said. Lorelli also said MobileMedia was moving ahead with plans to test its narrowband personal communication services (NPCS) network.
